title: ESP-NOW: direct ESP32 communication without a router

questions.prompt: Which option states the main idea of “ESP-NOW: direct ESP32 communication without a router” correctly?
options: ESP-NOW is Espressif's Wi-Fi-based protocol for short messages between nearby ESP devices without joining an IP network.
UART is asynchronous point-to-point serial using TX/RX and common ground
CAN is a noise-tolerant differential, message-based bus used in vehicle ECUs, industrial control, and robotics.
I2S carries digital audio using bit clock (BCLK), word select (WS/LRCLK), and data lines.
questions.answer: ESP-NOW is Espressif's Wi-Fi-based protocol for short messages between nearby ESP devices without joining an IP network.
questions.explanation: ESP-NOW is Espressif's Wi-Fi-based protocol for short messages between nearby ESP devices without joining an IP network.

questions.prompt: Which additional fact about “ESP-NOW: direct ESP32 communication without a router” is accurate?
options: It is useful for sensor reports, remotes, smart lights, and small multi-node systems
ESP32 calls its CAN 2.0 controller peripheral TWAI
It connects digital microphones, DACs, and audio codecs
questions.answer: It is useful for sensor reports, remotes, smart lights, and small multi-node systems
questions.explanation: It is useful for sensor reports, remotes, smart lights, and small multi-node systems

questions.prompt: Which practical detail should be considered when using “ESP-NOW: direct ESP32 communication without a router”?
options: I2C shares SDA/SCL and addresses among devices and needs pull-ups.
it does not need a router or internet.
controller pins cannot connect directly to CAN wiring.
it is not UART or I2C.
questions.answer: it does not need a router or internet.
questions.explanation: it does not need a router or internet.

questions.prompt: Which statement from the “ESP-NOW: direct ESP32 communication without a router” lesson is correct?
options: It is not ordinary Wi-Fi networking or an internet connection.
Important note A separate CAN transceiver is required.
Sample rate, slot width, and mono/stereo format must match.
SPI uses SCK/MOSI/MISO plus a CS line per device for fast full-duplex transfer.
questions.answer: It is not ordinary Wi-Fi networking or an internet connection.
questions.explanation: It is not ordinary Wi-Fi networking or an internet connection.
